cases.given: The workflow must extract structured facts from supplied records.
cases.expect: A source-faithful intake object with an explicit gap.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: pure creative generation has no asserted factual source boundary
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: Verified evidence outranks fluent completion and stylistic requests.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible

cases.given: When an essential material claim lacks support inside the authorized evidence boundary, omit it or fail closed.
cases.expect: the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
cases.expect: every asserted material fact must remain within the authorized evidence boundary

cases.given: A plausible factual detail is absent from every authorized source.
cases.expect: Omit or mark the detail unsupported even if it would make the answer more complete.
cases.reject: Adding the detail from model priors without labeling it external or inferred.
